args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Monitoring post-rollback health.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — Created incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer was paged.

## Verification

Post-rollback status confirms the service is now **healthy** (error rate dropped to 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback went to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
